description: ToxBench: Comparative benchmark dataset for evaluating hallucination and predictive accuracy of toxicology decision-support agents. Grounded in MedHallu (ACL 2025), RAGTruth (ACL 2024), AgentHallu (2026), and FActScore (EMNLP 2023) methodologies.
